title: RCSE v1.0.1 — cleaned reproduction package
description: Research code, derived datasets, saved models, numerical outputs, figures, and detailed reproduction instructions for Risk-Calibrated Selective Execution. Version v1.0.1 excludes manuscript files, reviewer correspondence, manuscript-editing helpers, editorial change logs, and the reference-check report. Analysis code and numerical results are unchanged. Original code is MIT licensed; BPI Challenge 2019 source-data attribution remains governed by separate CC BY 4.0 terms.
